```{r plate-heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=!is_compact}
tryCatch({
  cat(tr("heatmap_desc", lang), "\n\n")

  # Enrich with sample-group labels for the hover tooltip
  .group_lookup <- data_long %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Row, Column, SampleType, SampleID) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Column = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(Column))))

  heatmap_data <- data_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(MeasurementValue)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Row    = factor(Row, levels = LETTERS[1:8]),
      Column = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(Column)))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Row) & !is.na(Column)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(.group_lookup, by = c("Row", "Column", "SampleType", "SampleID")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      well_id   = paste0(as.character(Row), Column),
      bb0_label = if (isTRUE(is_elisa) && "calculated_bb0" %in% names(.)) {
        paste0(round(calculated_bb0, 1), "% B/B0")
      } else { "" },
      hover_txt = paste0(
        "Well: ",   well_id,          "<br>",
        "Raw OD: ", round(MeasurementValue, 4), "<br>",
        ifelse(nzchar(bb0_label), paste0(bb0_label, "<br>"), ""),
        "Group: ",  SampleType,       "<br>",
        "ID: ",     SampleID
      )
    )

  if (nrow(heatmap_data) > 0) {
    if (is_html_out()) {
      # Interactive plotly heatmap for HTML
      hm_plotly <- plot_ly(
        data        = heatmap_data,
        x           = ~factor(Column, levels = 1:12),
        y           = ~factor(as.character(Row), levels = rev(LETTERS[1:8])),
        z           = ~MeasurementValue,
        text        = ~hover_txt,
        hoverinfo   = "text",
        type        = "heatmap",
        colorscale  = list(c(0, "#2166AC"), c(0.5, "#F7F7F7"), c(1, "#B2182B")),
        colorbar    = list(title = "Value"),
        showscale   = TRUE
      ) %>%
        layout(
          xaxis = list(title = "Column", tickvals = 1:12),
          yaxis = list(title = "Row"),
          margin = list(l = 50, r = 20, t = 40, b = 50)
        )
      htmltools::tagList(hm_plotly)
    } else {
      # Static ggplot for DOCX/PDF
      heatmap_plot <- ggplot(heatmap_data,
                             aes(x = factor(Column), y = Row, fill = MeasurementValue)) +
        geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
        geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", MeasurementValue)), size = 3.5, color = "black") +
        scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#B2182B",
                             midpoint = median(heatmap_data$MeasurementValue, na.rm = TRUE),
                             name = "Value") +
        scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(factor(heatmap_data$Row, levels = LETTERS[1:8])))) +
        labs(x = "Column", y = "Row", title = tr("heatmap_title", lang)) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
              axis.text  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
              plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
      print(heatmap_plot)
    }
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("\n\n*Heatmap unavailable for this run.*\n\n")
})
```

```{r plate-positional-qc, results='asis', eval=!is_compact}
section_start("Plate Positional Quality")
positional <- if (exists("data_long")) assess_plate_positional(data_long) else NULL
if (!is.null(positional)) {
  if (positional$flagged_rows > 0 || positional$flagged_cols > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("**Warning:** %d row(s) and %d column(s) deviate >2 SD from plate mean, suggesting possible edge effects.\n\n",
                positional$flagged_rows, positional$flagged_cols))
  } else {
    cat("No significant row or column bias detected (all within 2 SD of plate mean).\n\n")
  }
  row_display <- positional$row_stats
  row_display$Mean <- round(row_display$Mean, 3)
  row_display$SD   <- round(row_display$SD,   3)
  # Empty-flag cells: show a pass pill for HTML, blank for DOCX/PDF
  if (is_html_out())
    row_display$Flag <- ifelse(row_display$Flag == "",
                               '<span class="bs-status-pill is-pass">OK</span>',
                               row_display$Flag)
  names(row_display) <- c("Row", "Mean Response", "SD", "Flag")
  render_table(row_display, caption = "Response by Row", escape = !is_html_out())
}
section_end()
```

```{r report-interpretation, results='asis'}
tryCatch({
  qc_issues <- c()

  # Use assay-specific QC profile for thresholds (M7)
  interp_qc_profile <- get_qc_profile(assay_config$assay_type %||% "rba")

  r2_val <- if (exists("model_stats") && !is.null(model_stats)) model_stats$r_squared %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_
  if (!is.na(r2_val) && is.finite(r2_val) && r2_val < interp_qc_profile$r2_threshold) {
    qc_issues <- c(qc_issues, sprintf("Low R\u00b2 (%.3f < %.2f threshold)", r2_val, interp_qc_profile$r2_threshold))
  }

  hill_val <- if (exists("model_stats") && !is.null(model_stats)) model_stats$hill_slope %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_
  if (!is.na(hill_val) && is.finite(hill_val)) {
    abs_hill <- abs(hill_val)
    abs_range <- sort(abs(interp_qc_profile$hill_slope_range))
    if (abs_hill < abs_range[1] || abs_hill > abs_range[2]) {
      qc_issues <- c(qc_issues, sprintf("Unusual Hill slope (%.2f; expected |slope| in %.1f to %.1f)",
                                          hill_val, abs_range[1], abs_range[2]))
    }
  }

  if (exists("replicate_stats") && !is.null(replicate_stats) && "cv_percent" %in% names(replicate_stats)) {
    max_cv <- max(replicate_stats$cv_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(max_cv) && max_cv > interp_qc_profile$cv_limit) {
      qc_issues <- c(qc_issues, sprintf("High sample CV (max %.1f%% > %d%% limit)", max_cv, interp_qc_profile$cv_limit))
    }
  }

  if (length(qc_issues) == 0) {
    cat("All quality criteria met. Results are suitable for reporting.\n\n")
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("**Quality warnings detected:** %s. Review flagged items before use.\n\n",
                paste(qc_issues, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  # M6: Quantification status counts
  if (exists("sample_results") && !is.null(sample_results) && nrow(sample_results) > 0 &&
      "quantification_status" %in% names(sample_results)) {
    status_counts <- table(sample_results$quantification_status)
    cat("**Quantification status breakdown (per well):**\n\n")
    for (s in names(status_counts)) {
      cat(sprintf("- %s: %d\n", s, status_counts[[s]]))
    }
    cat("\n")
  }

  cat(sprintf("\n*QC profile: %s (R\u00b2 >= %.2f, CV <= %d%%, Hill slope [%.1f, %.1f], Recovery [%d%%, %d%%])*\n\n",
              toupper(assay_config$assay_type %||% "rba"),
              interp_qc_profile$r2_threshold,
              interp_qc_profile$cv_limit,
              interp_qc_profile$hill_slope_range[1],
              interp_qc_profile$hill_slope_range[2],
              interp_qc_profile$recovery_range[1],
              interp_qc_profile$recovery_range[2]))
}, error = function(e) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n*Interpretation section failed: %s*\n\n", e$message))
})
```
